newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF passes on soymeal, wheat tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF passes on soymeal, wheat tenders.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Tuesday it passed on a tender to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal due to high offer prices.

An official with the federation said it also passed on tenders for 30,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet, 14,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal and 52,000 tonnes of feed wheat because of higher-than-expected prices.
The official said the federation had passed on the tenders last Friday for the same reason.
The lowest bid for the soymeal was made by Andre at $310.75 a tonne C&F for arrival by September 30, traders said.
They said the lowest bid for the feed wheat was made at $141.95 a tonne C&F by Daewoo Corp with Canadian origin.
